in_marathi.name: Gajdant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gajdant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gajdant is derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'one who has elephant-like pride'. It is a name of power and strength, evoking images of majestic elephants and their unwavering confidence.
